summary: International Stem Cell Corporation filed an 8-K on September 1, 2026 confirming completion of its sale of 100% of the membership interests in subsidiary Lifeline Cell Technology, LLC to American Type Culture Collection, Inc. under a July 10, 2026 Membership Interest Purchase Agreement. No price, premium, or consideration terms were disclosed in the excerpt. The company voluntarily sought and received stockholder approval on July 10, 2026, filing an information statement August 4, 2026. Pro forma financials treat the disposition as occurring January 1, 2024. Watch for purchase-price disclosure, use of proceeds, and any remaining shell/going-concern overhang.
